hero.title: What Is Included on a Seabourn Cruise?
hero.subtitle: One of the biggest advantages of booking a Seabourn cruise is the breadth of the included experience.
readMoreParagraphs: Seabourn is designed around an ultra-luxury model where many expenses that can become add-ons on other cruise lines are already part of the cruise experience. Dining, premium spirits and wines, Wi-Fi, gratuities, entertainment, and a number of onboard experiences are included, while certain excursions, spa treatments, premium services and other personal expenses may cost extra.
For travelers comparing Seabourn with other luxury cruise lines, understanding exactly what is includedand what is notis essential for comparing the true value of the fare.
This guide breaks down Seabourn cruise inclusions by category so you can understand what you are paying for before you book.

quickAnswer.title: What Is Included on Seabourn?
quickAnswer.intro: A Seabourn cruise generally includes accommodation, dining, premium beverages, Wi-Fi, gratuities and entertainment. However, not everything is included in the cruise fare  the exact inclusions can vary by ship, itinerary and voyage, so travelers should review the specific sailing before booking.
included: Access to public areas and pools

allInclusive.title: Is Seabourn All-Inclusive?
paragraphs: Seabourn is often described as an all-inclusive or ultra-luxury cruise experience, but 'all-inclusive' does not mean absolutely everything is free.

The core onboard experience includes a remarkably broad range of services and amenities  but optional services and certain shore experiences can still cost extra. That distinction is important when comparing Seabourn with other luxury cruise brands.

dining.title: Seabourn Dining Is Included
dining.lead: One of the strongest inclusions is dining.
dining.body: Seabourn includes dining across its primary onboard restaurants, allowing guests to enjoy multiple meals without paying restaurant-by-restaurant charges.
dining.venuesLabel: Depending on the ship, dining options can include:

subCards.title: The Restaurant
subCards.description: The Restaurant is Seabourn's primary fine-dining venue. Guests can enjoy multi-course meals in an elegant setting without a separate restaurant charge.

subCards.title: The Colonnade
subCards.description: The Colonnade offers a more relaxed dining environment, with options for breakfast, lunch and dinner depending on the sailing.

subCards.title: In-Suite Dining
subCards.description: Guests can also enjoy meals privately in their suite. For travelers celebrating a honeymoon, anniversary or other milestone, having dinner delivered to the suite or veranda can be one of the most enjoyable ways to experience Seabourn.

beverages.title: Premium Spirits and Fine Wines Are Included
beverages.lead: Seabourn includes premium spirits and fine wines as part of its onboard experience.
beverages.body: This is an important distinction for travelers comparing cruise fares. On some cruise lines, beverages beyond basic options require a separate beverage package. With Seabourn, many premium alcoholic beverages are already included.
beverages.note: Note: Availability can vary by venue and specific product.

cta1.title: Explore the Full Seabourn Experience
cta1.description: Inclusions are just one part of the story. See the complete guide to Seabourn's ships, suites and destinations to plan your voyage from start to finish.

groupedAmenities.title: Welcome Champagne, In-Suite Bar, Caviar & Wi-Fi

cards.title: Welcome Champagne Is Included
cards.description: Guests are welcomed with Champagne as part of the Seabourn experience. It is a small detail, but it reflects the line's emphasis on luxury from the moment you step onboard. For travelers booking a special celebration, this contributes to the overall sense that the cruise is designed as a premium hospitality experience rather than simply transportation between ports.

cards.title: An In-Suite Bar Is Included
cards.description: Seabourn suites feature an in-suite bar stocked according to guest preferences. Depending on the ship and suite, travelers can request preferred beverages. This means guests can enjoy a drink privately in their suite or on their veranda without needing to visit a bar.
cards.listTitle: This can be particularly useful for:

cards.title: Caviar Is Included
cards.description: Caviar is one of Seabourn's signature luxury touches. Complimentary caviar is available onboard, reinforcing the brand's emphasis on elevated dining. For luxury travelers, this is an important distinction because caviar is frequently treated as a premium add-on elsewhere.
items: As part of the line's signature culinary offering
cards.footnote: Note: Availability and presentation can vary by ship and itinerary.

cards.title: Wi-Fi Is Included
cards.description: Seabourn includes Wi-Fi as part of its onboard experience. The line has also expanded connectivity through Starlink-powered Wi-Fi on its ships. This means guests can stay connected without necessarily purchasing the traditional internet package found on many cruise lines.
cards.footnote: Note: Connection speeds and availability can vary depending on location and satellite coverage.

gratuities.title: Gratuities Are Included
gratuities.lead: One of the most useful Seabourn inclusions is gratuities.
gratuities.intro: Seabourn states that tipping is neither required nor expected. That means travelers generally do not need to budget for the daily automatic gratuities that are common on many mainstream cruise lines.

gratuities.outro: Seabourn's more inclusive approach makes the initial cruise fare easier to evaluate.

entertainment.title: Entertainment Is Included
entertainment.lead: Seabourn includes onboard entertainment as part of the cruise experience.
entertainment.intro: The emphasis is generally on intimate and sophisticated entertainment rather than the large-scale productions found on mega-ships.

conversations.body: For travelers who prefer intellectual enrichment over large-scale entertainment, this can be a significant part of the onboard experience.

items.text: Guests can use the ship's fitness facilities without paying a separate daily access fee. Personal training and specialized services may carry an additional charge.

items.title: Pools and Public Spaces Are Included
items.text: Access to Seabourn's onboard public areas is included in the cruise fare. There is no separate resort-style daily access fee for these standard onboard facilities.

shoreVentures.intro: This is where travelers need to pay close attention  not every shore experience is automatically part of the fare.

cards.title: Seabourn Shore Excursions: Are They Included?
cards.text: This is where travelers need to pay close attention. Not every Seabourn shore excursion is included in the cruise fare. Seabourn offers a broad portfolio of shore experiences, and some excursions are optional purchases.

cards.title: Ventures by Seabourn: Is It Included?
cards.text: Ventures by Seabourn experiences may cost extra. These are specialized active and expedition-style experiences that are particularly attractive to adventurous travelers, but they should be considered separately when calculating the total cost of your trip.
cards.featuresTitle: These can include activities such as:

cards.title: Is Room Service Included on Seabourn?
cards.text: Yes, Seabourn offers in-suite dining. Guests can enjoy meals in the privacy of their suite rather than dining in a restaurant  particularly valuable for breakfast on the veranda, quiet dinners, couples, special occasions and travelers who prefer privacy.

cards.title: Is Specialty Dining Included on Seabourn?
cards.text: Seabourn's dining model is significantly more inclusive than cruise lines that charge separately for every specialty restaurant. Dining venues included vary by ship. Some special culinary experiences, private events or premium offerings may have an additional charge.

cards.title: Are Alcoholic Drinks Included on Seabourn?
cards.text: Yes, many alcoholic beverages are included: fine wines, premium spirits, Champagne, beer and cocktails. Availability can vary by venue and product, and travelers generally do not need to purchase a separate standard beverage package.

cards.title: Is Champagne Included on Seabourn?
cards.text: Yes. Seabourn includes Champagne as part of its onboard luxury experience, including a welcome Champagne  one of the small details that distinguishes the line from more mainstream cruise experiences.

cards.title: Are Soft Drinks Included on Seabourn?
cards.text: Yes, non-alcoholic beverages are part of the onboard experience, including soft drinks, bottled water, coffee, tea, juices and other non-alcoholic refreshments.

cards.title: Are Laundry Services Included?
cards.text: Standard laundry and dry-cleaning services should be treated as additional expenses unless specifically included with a particular fare, suite benefit or promotion. Check current pricing and applicable suite-level benefits on longer voyages.

cards.title: Is the Spa Included on Seabourn?
cards.text: Access to standard ship facilities may be included, but spa treatments  massages, facials, beauty treatments, specialized wellness treatments and salon services  are generally additional expenses to budget separately.

cards.title: Are Shore Excursions Included?
cards.text: Not all shore excursions are included. Pricing varies according to the type of experience, with private tours, specialty culinary experiences, exclusive cultural activities, adventure excursions, premium transportation and specialized local experiences typically costing extra.

trueCost.title: How Seabourn's Inclusions Affect the True Cruise Cost
trueCost.intro: A useful way to compare luxury cruises is to look beyond the advertised fare. A lower cruise fare may initially appear attractive, but travelers may then add a beverage package, a Wi-Fi package, daily gratuities, specialty dining and premium activities  and the final price can become considerably higher. Seabourn's inclusive model means many of these costs are already incorporated.
trueCost.noteQuestionText: "What will my total trip cost be after adding the experiences I actually want?"
trueCost.noteOutro: That is a much better way to compare Seabourn with competing luxury cruise lines.

faq.question: Is Seabourn all-inclusive?
faq.answer: Seabourn offers a broad all-inclusive luxury cruise experience, with accommodation, dining, premium beverages, Wi-Fi, gratuities and many onboard experiences included. Optional services and certain excursions can cost extra.

faq.question: Are drinks included on Seabourn?
faq.answer: Yes. Seabourn includes many premium spirits, fine wines, Champagne, beer and non-alcoholic beverages.

faq.question: Is Wi-Fi included on Seabourn?
faq.answer: Yes. Wi-Fi is included as part of the Seabourn experience, with connectivity supported by Starlink on the fleet.

faq.question: Are gratuities included on Seabourn?
faq.answer: Yes. Seabourn states that tipping is neither required nor expected.

faq.question: Is caviar included on Seabourn?
faq.answer: Yes. Complimentary caviar is one of Seabourn's signature luxury offerings.

faq.question: Is dining included on Seabourn?
faq.answer: Yes. Dining at Seabourn's primary onboard restaurants is included, along with in-suite dining.

faq.question: Is room service included on Seabourn?
faq.answer: Seabourn offers in-suite dining, allowing guests to enjoy meals privately in their suite.

faq.question: Are shore excursions included on Seabourn?
faq.answer: Not all shore excursions are included. Many optional shore experiences and specialized tours carry additional charges.

faq.question: Are Seabourn expedition excursions included?
faq.answer: Many core expedition activities are included on expedition voyages, while certain specialized or optional experiences can cost extra.

faq.question: Is the spa included on Seabourn?
faq.answer: Use of standard onboard facilities may be included, but spa treatments, massages, facials and salon services are generally additional.

faq.question: Is Champagne included on Seabourn?
faq.answer: Yes. Champagne is included as part of Seabourn's onboard beverage offering, including a welcome Champagne.

faq.question: Are premium wines included on Seabourn?
faq.answer: Yes. Seabourn includes fine wines and premium spirits as part of its onboard experience.

faq.question: Does Seabourn charge for specialty dining?
faq.answer: Seabourn includes multiple dining venues, although specific specialty culinary experiences or offerings can vary by ship and itinerary.

faq.question: Does Seabourn include laundry?
faq.answer: Travelers should generally budget separately for laundry and dry-cleaning unless a specific fare, suite benefit or promotion includes the service.

faq.question: Are airfare and transfers included on Seabourn?
faq.answer: Not automatically in every cruise fare. Airfare, transfers and pre- or post-cruise arrangements depend on the booking package or promotion.

faq.question: Are Seabourn shore excursions expensive?
faq.answer: Pricing varies significantly by experience. Private tours, specialized adventures and exclusive experiences generally cost more than standard sightseeing.

faq.question: Is Seabourn worth it if I don't drink alcohol?
faq.answer: It can be. Seabourn's value also comes from suites, dining, service, Wi-Fi, gratuities, entertainment, enrichment and destination experiences.

faq.question: How can I compare the true cost of a Seabourn cruise?
faq.answer: Compare the cruise fare together with airfare, hotels, transfers, excursions, spa treatments and personal spending. Then compare that total with competing luxury cruise lines.

finalVerdict.eyebrow: Final Verdict: What Is Included on Seabourn?
finalVerdict.title: Compare the Value, Not Just the Fare
paragraphs: Seabourn provides one of the more comprehensive luxury cruise experiences, with dining, premium beverages, Champagne, caviar, Wi-Fi, gratuities, entertainment and enrichment forming the foundation of the onboard experience. The biggest expenses to watch are generally optional shore excursions, spa treatments, private experiences, travel arrangements and personal purchases.

Our recommendation: Don't compare Seabourn based solely on the advertised cruise fare. Compare the total value of what is already included. For travelers who appreciate premium dining, drinks, personalized service, suite accommodation and a largely cash-free onboard experience, those inclusions can make Seabourn a compelling luxury cruise choice.
